parameters.description: A single clean pixel art ground tile. A tall diamond TOP in 4:3 width-to-height proportion, with very thin straight side walls. Elevated orthographic camera with clearly visible top surface. Muted olive green flat top, very quiet low contrast colors from supplied palette. Add sparse but readable GRASS BLADES on the surface: THREE clearly visible short grass tufts, each a 3x3 pixel cluster, separated across the top. The tufts are not dots. Broad calm flat color, no noise, stones, cracks, flowers, shading texture or random pixels. 85 percent empty area; visible low grass blades occupying only 15 percent. Transparent background, no shadow, no text. Full tile inside canvas. Camera elevated like Into the Breach.
